products_or_families: Diamond Drive; Diamond Compressor boundary; Memory Lane boundary
relationship_notes: Michael Knappe and Tim Fifield began the Diamond Drive as a hobby in 2003; first shipment of approximately 30 hand-built Diamond Drive pedals left Halifax in June 2004. Compressor first shipped March 2005. Memory Lane first shipped July 2005. Keep PolyBlend Systems as corporate origin and Diamond as pedal brand.

products_or_families: Robotalk 1; AC Booster; RC Booster; BB Preamp
relationship_notes: Xotic traces roots to 1996; Robotalk 1 was designed and introduced in 1998. Xotic says the brand was formally reborn under Prosound Communications Inc. in August 2000. AC Booster arrived September 2002, RC Booster November 2002, BB Preamp January 2005. Preserve the bass/preamp origin separately from the guitar-pedal catalog.

Brian Hermida's first pedal was the Mosferatu in 2003. Zendrive developed from an earlier design sent to Robben Ford and was officially released in 2004. Zendrive 2 is a later tube overdrive/distortion state, separately anchored to 2006 specialist indexing. Keep later Lovepedal manufacturing separate from original Hermida identity.

Pigtronix was founded in 2004. Disnortion came out in 2005 and is explicitly identified by Pigtronix as an original Howard Davis / David Koltai design. Later micro versions and successor products must remain separate production states.

products_or_families: Super Chili Picoso; later early dirt queue
relationship_notes: Catalinbread was born in June 2003 on Nicholas Harris's kitchen table after ToneFactor asked to sell Super Chili Picoso. The early catalog expanded rapidly, but exact dirt-product launch dates should be assigned individually rather than inferred from company founding.

products_or_families: Screamer; Screamer Fuzz; early pedal catalog
relationship_notes: Cusack Music was founded in 2002 as a family-run garage side project. Effects Database anchors the Cusack Screamer and Screamer Fuzz to September 2005, making them strong early dirt records. Do not assume every current Cusack model belongs to the founding-era catalog.

products_or_families: Blues Pro; Crunch Box; Tube Zone; Classic Distortion; Blue Boy; G.I. Fuzz; Neo Fuzz; later Super Crunch Box
relationship_notes: Effects Database indexes a 20-product MI Audio universe with a substantial dirt catalog. Crunch Box is a major early family; preserve Blues Pro, Tube Zone and later Super Crunch Box as separate retail states.

products_or_families: Red Snapper; Blue Collar; later King of the Brit and related gain families
relationship_notes: Menatone's own site states Red Snapper debuted in 1996 and Blue Collar in 1997. These are genuine early builder anchors, while current PTP/mini versions should be modeled as later production states.
